treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and capital gains (1993, as amended 2018)
eif_quote: gov.uk: '1993 Uzbekistan Double Taxation Convention – in force ... entered into force on 10 June 1994'; 'An amending protocol was signed on 24 January 2018. It entered into force on 1 June 2018.'
source_title: UK–Uzbekistan Double Taxation Convention 1993 as amended by 2018 Protocol (gov.uk consolidated text) + 2018 Protocol

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which controls, directly or indirectly, at least 10 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividends (other than where the dividends are paid by an investment vehicle as mentioned in subparagraph (b));
c) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: treaty art. 23(2) (as replaced by 2018 Protocol art. XI)
ppt.quote: (2) Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital gains if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Art. 10(2) was replaced by the 2018 Protocol (in force 01.06.2018; Protocol art. XVI: WHT for amounts paid on/after the first day of the second month following entry into force -> 2018-08-01). The 5%/10% tiers already existed in the original 1993 text (lex.uz Russian text: 'a) 5 процентов ... по меньшей мере 10 процентов решающих голосов ... b) 10 процентов ... во всех остальных случаях'), so valid_from kept at original effect (Uzbekistan: 1 January of year after EIF = 1995-01-01; UK: 6/1 April 1995). The 15% tier for real-estate investment vehicles was added in 2018. Div 5% threshold is voting power (direct or indirect). Art. 23(1) remittance-basis limitation also applies. [curated: dropped DIVIDEND tier — 15% applies only to property investment vehicles]
